Preserved completed reviewer qualification 006. Its one-time run passed every frozen gate: 24/24 clean accepts, 24/24 defect rejects, 4/4 per mutation class, 49/49 responses, zero malformed/provider errors, USD 0.012175 cost, synthetic-only inputs, and no authority for 10,000-case execution. Prospective method, cost, and data-boundary review confirmed 24 new deterministic clean/defect pairs disjoint from 006, exact hosted Qwen3.7 Plus routing, 49 calls with no retries, a USD 0.10 hard stop, synthetic-only inputs, complete identity/error/latency/cost gates, Mistral Small 4 fallback, and no authority for the 100- or 10,000-case stages.

Completed attempt-001 review preserves the exact executed 100-case bindings and records Refine with authorization revoked; the instrument retains its 246-call, zero-retry, USD 3 emergency, deterministic-authority, no-promotion, and no-1,000/10,000 boundaries.

Completed attempt-002 review preserves the valid Refine result and revoked authorization: 93/100 deterministic-valid, 100% citation validity, 97% reviewer agreement, 20/20 mutation rejection, 225 calls, USD 0.102517, and no authority for 1,000/10,000 stages.

Preserved unexecuted 001 instrument. A complete manual 120-blueprint review found source-grain, visual-diversity, boundary-context, mutation-sampling, citation-completeness, and disagreement-gating defects; its bounded execution authorization is revoked and corrected 002 supersedes it without erasing the unfavorable review.

Manual source and methodology review confirmed corrected 002 binds immutable base and source-design hashes, defines 120 cases over 48 anchored claims, requires genuine two-source evidence, adds disagreement/dispute and human-audit-capacity gates, preserves strict provider/cost boundaries, is frozen for one exact bounded rehearsal, and cannot authorize 10,000-case scale.

Manual source-grounding review verified 30 exact text-claim citation anchors against immutable evidence, 18 distinct facts against six synthetic visual fixtures, 18 explicit two-source cases, corrected course-aligned boundary labels, all-course cross-confusion coverage, 120 unique intents, and a 29/31/29/31 course distribution.

Manual correction review confirmed successor 003 preserves the exact reviewed 120-case source design, adds two paid pre-bulk provider canaries, caps total calls at 286 and cost at USD 3, records the synthetic-public-only request-level ZDR exception while denying data collection, prohibits private data and 10,000-case scale, and is frozen for one exact bounded rehearsal.

Manual policy-scope review confirmed frozen successor 004 preserves the exact 120-case source and canary-gated execution design, explicitly allows provider collection and retention only for committed synthetic-public evaluation fixtures, excludes every private/product/course/instructor/student path, caps calls at 286 and cost at USD 3, prohibits 10,000-case scale, and still requires a clean preflight plus explicit paid-run approval.

Preserved frozen 005 instrument after its one-time execution became invalid during dispute review. Both canaries and pre-dispute stages completed, one DeepSeek response contained malformed JSON, completed metrics and exact accounting were not persisted, authorization is revoked, and no 10,000-case scale is allowed.
